result.instructions: Tools for tefacturo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the SUNAT status of invoice FFA2-15."; "Get the PDF of receipt BBV5-4 so I can send it to the customer."; "Preview this invoice layout before we file it with SUNAT.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes tefacturo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tefacturo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tefacturo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tefacturo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tefacturo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tefacturo_get_status
tools.title: Get document status
tools.description: Get the three states of one issued document: SUNAT answer (estadoSunat), declaration (estadoComprobante) and mail delivery (estadoEntrega), with the declaration text. Use it before a document is sent again. Read-only.

serie.description: Series of the document, for example FFA2. Invoices start with F, receipts with B.

tipoComprobante.description: Document type: 01 invoice, 03 receipt (boleta), 07 credit note, 08 debit note.

tools.name: tefacturo_get_xml
tools.title: Get document XML
tools.description: Get the signed UBL XML of one issued document. The reply holds xmlFirma, the XML in base64, and hashCode (may be null). Read-only.

serie.description: Series of the document, for example FFA2. Invoices start with F, receipts with B.

tipoComprobante.description: Document type: 01 invoice, 03 receipt (boleta), 07 credit note, 08 debit note.

tools.name: tefacturo_get_pdf
tools.title: Get document PDF
tools.description: Get the printed PDF of one issued document, as a base64 string (decode it to a .pdf file). Read-only.

serie.description: Series of the document, for example FFA2. Invoices start with F, receipts with B.

tipoComprobante.description: Document type: 01 invoice, 03 receipt (boleta), 07 credit note, 08 debit note.

tools.name: tefacturo_get_cdr
tools.title: Get SUNAT receipt (CDR)
tools.description: Get the SUNAT receipt (CDR) of one document as a base64 ZIP that holds an XML answer from SUNAT. The CDR proves SUNAT accepted the document. Read-only.

serie.description: Series of the document, for example FFA2. Invoices start with F, receipts with B.

tipoComprobante.description: Document type: 01 invoice, 03 receipt (boleta), 07 credit note, 08 debit note.

tools.name: tefacturo_preview_document
tools.title: Preview a document
tools.description: Render a PDF preview of a document from its JSON, without a number and without a SUNAT filing (the tool sets datosDocumento.numero to 0). Use it to check the layout before tefacturo_emit_invoice. Read-only. Returns base64Pdf.

payload.description: Use the same JSON as the tefacturo docs for this document (close2u, datosDocumento, detalleDocumento, emisor, receptor, informacionAdicional). The emisor.numeroDocumentoIdentidad must be this login's RUC; the tool sets it and rejects another RUC.

tools.name: tefacturo_emit_invoice
tools.title: Emit an invoice (files with SUNAT)
tools.description: SUNAT FILING, IRREVERSIBLE: files a new invoice (factura, type 01) with SUNAT for this login's RUC. The numero must be new: check the series with tefacturo_get_status first. Use tefacturo_preview_document to check the layout first. Use the same JSON as the tefacturo docs for this document (close2u, datosDocumento, detalleDocumento, emisor, receptor, informacionAdicional). The emisor.numeroDocumentoIdentidad must be this login's RUC; the tool sets it and rejects another RUC.

tools.name: tefacturo_void_documents
tools.title: Void documents (files with SUNAT)
tools.description: SUNAT FILING, IRREVERSIBLE: sends a voiding summary (resumen de baja) that cancels issued invoices or receipts. The payload holds fechaGeneracion, fechaDocumentoBaja and resumenBajaItemList (serie, numero, tipoComprobante 01 or 03, motivo). SUNAT processes it later: check it with tefacturo_get_status. Use the same JSON as the tefacturo docs for this document (close2u, datosDocumento, detalleDocumento, emisor, receptor, informacionAdicional). The emisor.numeroDocumentoIdentidad must be this login's RUC; the tool sets it and rejects another RUC.
